europe_now.summary: Voters across Spain are preparing to participate in a high-stakes snap election with significant political and economic implications. Party leaders held their final campaign events to rally supporters as polls closed in on potential shifts in governance.

europe_now.title: S&P Revises France's Credit Outlook to Negative
